With presence in 35 hotels, 4 countries, 18 destinations, 3.433 rooms and 2.000 collaborators, GHL operates hotels across Latin America.
items.currentLiveValue: GHL Hoteles is a Latin American hospitality operator that manages a multi-brand portfolio spanning proprietary GHL brands and international affiliations. The company supports owners and investors with end-to-end hotel operations—commercial, revenue, F&B, and property-level execution—across diverse markets in Central America, the Andean region, and the Southern Cone. GHL emphasizes scalable operating processes, brand-standard coordination, and locally relevant guest experiences while maintaining portfolio discipline across urban, resort, and mixed-demand environments.
